newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in line with softer Japanese prices, brokers said. They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down on some selling interest, prompted by lingering concerns over rising domestic stocks.

"There was no offtake at all in the morning. Nobody wanted to trade. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe. It's going to remain soft over the short-term because production and supplies remained ample," a commodity house dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, January/March RSS3 slipped half a cent to 131.00 U.S. cents a kg.
January/March RSS1 fell 1.50 cents to 189.00 Singapore cents (US$1.35) a kg.
July/September TSR20 eased 0.25 cent to 184.00 Singapore cents (US$1.31) a kg.
